data.long_meaning: From the Greek word γαρβος (garbos), meaning 'farm worker' or 'reaper'. In the Bible, this name is not found. The name Garvy carries the meaning “Farm worker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garvy usually hope their child will grow to embody farm worker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
